description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeys generateRequest functionality in a media server context, using Google Test framework. It defines a test fixture class and three test cases to verify successful request generation, failure due to non-existent session, and failure due to session API error.

methods.description: Destructor cleaning up media keys after tests.
